content: प्रभु {%a.%} (भु, -भ्वी|{%f.%}) .²1 Mighty, strong, powerful. .²2 Able, competent, having power to (with <ab>inf.</ab> or in <ab>comp.</ab>); ऋषिप्रभावान्मयि नान्तकोऽपि प्रभुः प्रहर्तुं किमुतान्यहिंस्राः <ls>R. 2. 62</ls>; समाधिभेदप्रभवो भवन्ति <ls>Ku. 3. 40</ls>. .²3 A match for; प्रभुर्मल्लो मल्लाय <ls>Mbh.</ls> .²4 Abundant. .²5 Ever-lasting, eternal. .{@-भुः@} .²1 A lord, master; प्रभुर्बुभूषुर्भुवनत्रयस्य यः <ls>Śi. 1. 49</ls>. .²2 A governor, ruler, supreme authority. .²3 An owner, proprietor. .²4 Quick-silver. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²6 Of Śiva. .²7 Of Brahmā; <ab>cf.</ab> समीक्ष्य प्रभवस्त्रयः <ls>Bhāg. 4. 1. 21</ls>; (also applied to various gods as Indra, Sūrya, Agni). .²8 Word, sound.
